note: Requirements include conditional/alternative branches explained by special_condition and executable gates. This is a design contract, not an implemented provider claim.

rules.name: 严格周期信标
rules.sample_and_decision_gate: n≥8；5s≤Δt≤24h；CV(Δt)≤0.15；每次≤5 包（DetectHeartbeat）
rules.coverage_contract: Per-family/scope/window/population coverage; verified fields; missing inputs never imply not_observed. Follow existing per-rule positive/negative gates.
rules.special_condition: Per-contact packet count must be measured; alert counts or cumulative flow packets cannot substitute.

rules.name: 抖动周期信标
rules.sample_and_decision_gate: n≥16；median(Δt) 稳定且 0.15<CV≤0.40；Ljung-Box p<0.05 且 ACF 峰值>0.3
rules.coverage_contract: Per-family/scope/window/population coverage; verified fields; missing inputs never imply not_observed. Follow existing per-rule positive/negative gates.
rules.special_condition: Independent contact population; existing n>=16 and statistical rules remain authoritative.

rules.name: 每天固定时间点
rules.sample_and_decision_gate: ≥3 自然日且 ≥80% 命中落在同一 ≤2h 窗口
rules.coverage_contract: Per-family/scope/window/population coverage; verified fields; missing inputs never imply not_observed. Follow existing per-rule positive/negative gates.
rules.special_condition: Explicit day timezone; separate multi-day coverage from jitter coverage; keep >=3 days and 80%/2h rule.

rules.name: 跨日持续
rules.sample_and_decision_gate: 锁定窗口内逐日桶活跃 ≥2 天为 days2 / ≥3 天为 days3（不用首末两点推持续；固定资产/端点，需跨段时联合快照）
rules.coverage_contract: Per-family/scope/window/population coverage; verified fields; missing inputs never imply not_observed. Follow existing per-rule positive/negative gates.
rules.special_condition: Daily occupancy within a declared covered window, not merely first/last timestamps.

rules.name: 命中突发
rules.sample_and_decision_gate: peak_window(5m)/长期窗口均值 >p99 基线
rules.coverage_contract: Per-family/scope/window/population coverage; verified fields; missing inputs never imply not_observed. Follow existing per-rule positive/negative gates.

rules.name: 速率阶梯上升
rules.sample_and_decision_gate: 至少5个固定等长窗口；无并列值时精确双侧Mann-Kendall p<0.05；并列/缺窗标ineligible，禁止静默切渐近检验
rules.coverage_contract: Per-family/scope/window/population coverage; verified fields; missing inputs never imply not_observed. Follow existing per-rule positive/negative gates.
rules.special_condition: Counts saved matches per current contract; this is deliberately distinct from independent contacts.

rules.name: 长标签高基数子域（单资产）
rules.sample_and_decision_gate: PSL 归一后：独特子域比 >p95 且 标签长 p90 >p95 且 查询速率 >p95（同域基线）；单机高熵不支持 Botnet
rules.coverage_contract: Per-family/scope/window/population coverage; verified fields; missing inputs never imply not_observed. Follow existing per-rule positive/negative gates.

rules.special_condition: F supports hex/base32; semantic decode support is an independent capability and must not be inferred.

rules.name: 词形随机性（单资产）
